candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text is accurate. Furigana for 調査/結果 in ④ is dumped on a separate line (ちょうさ　けっか) instead of attached to the words, inconsistent with the other items. The first row of the word box is used as a table header. The underline on ひらがな is not marked. Book icon rendered as an emoji.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct and inline. Circled numbers are preserved, the word box is a table with an empty header, and the book icon is represented. Only miss is the underline on ひらがな.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct. The title is rendered as a heading, which is reasonable; the book icon is omitted. Circled numbers are kept. The underline on ひらがな is not marked.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are correct. Circled numbers ①–⑩ are replaced with a plain 1.–10. list, which is slightly less faithful. No icon or heading for the title. The underline on ひらがな is not marked.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are correct and inline, and circled numbers are preserved. The title is plain text with no icon or heading. The underline on ひらがな is not marked.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the text essentially perfectly, so the ranking turns on small formatting differences. B keeps the circled numbers, puts all furigana inline and represents the book icon. C and E are the same minus the icon, with C marking the title as a heading and E leaving it plain. D swaps the circled numbers for a generic numbered list. A is last because it detaches the furigana in item ④ onto a separate line and treats the first row of the word box as a table header.
